SHEIN has nice clothes, but their return process is terrible. I returned all of the items I purchased except for a bathing suit, which I knew was non-returnable. I included a copy of everything I was returning in the package, but I still haven't received my full refund.

I've been waiting for the rest of my money, and trying to contact customer service has been incredibly frustrating. When I call, I'm told that the department can't take my call and that I need to find another way to contact them. That's completely unacceptable.
If the return process were as easy and straightforward as placing an order, this would be a much better shopping experience.

data.review_body: Shein offers a very broad range of current styles at accessible prices, and the dress I ordered fit well and felt better than I expected for the cost. The product gave me good value, but the process around it was less polished. Shipping took longer than expected, tracking updates were inconsistent, and the way the dress was packed left deep creases that required steaming before it was wearable. The company's main strength is making trend-led clothing easy to browse and affordable to try. The weaknesses in this order were logistics, communication, and presentation on arrival. I would consider ordering again when I am not in a hurry, but more reliable tracking and better packaging would make the experience feel much more considered.
data.review_headline: Good value, but delivery felt uncertain

data.review_body:
Never had any issues with SHEIN in the past, but given my current order was missing several items this time totalling over £50 I tried to escalate with customer service for either a refund or have the items sent out, though was met by the response our computers show they were sent so no further action will be taken! Yes I was billed and told they were sent and they show in the package but nothing physically arrived! 
Appalling AI based customer service needs investigating by trading standards as they are taking your money and not supplying purchased items! Won’t be ordering from them again!!!!!

Clothing is hit or miss, though I think the nicer items are priced more and do perform well.
What do I hate?  The return process.  I signed in at about 2pm but it took me until almost 6pm to finish.  The site kept saying it couldn't process my return and try again later.  Problem, it doesn't save the return entries.  I had to re-enter all the information again, and it was during the 2nd time, I noticed 2 items were dropped from the list.  And don't return to the previous page because again, you will lose all the return information and have to re-enter it again.  Which is what I did.  I had 29 then 27 items to return.
Also I had a couple of items that didn't even show up for return or not.  A pair of pants and jeans, both too big weren't even on the list, so I couldn't process a return for them.  The loss from the system error and the missing items for return (pants and jeans were purchased at the same time as other pants and jeans processed for return)  was a loss of approximately $100.  I spent about $1300 in 3 separate orders.  I am not happy about that at all.
I don't hate the site and usually keep most of my orders.  I found the return process rather tedious.
data.review_headline: Clothinh is fine, returns are tedious
